Eye Pattern - Central Heterochromia.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Central Heterochromia
A ring of a different color surrounds the pupil — your secondary eye color forms a starburst at the center of each iris.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Central Heterochromia.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Each iris has a ring of the secondary eye color around the pupil, surrounded by the primary eye color at the outer edge. Apply central heterochromia using primary and secondary eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
